definition: `NecessaryExistence F x w`: at w, every essence of x is exemplified at every world accessible from w (AFP definition NE = (λx. ∀(λΦ. Φ ess x m→ □ (∃ Φ)))). A property of individuals defined through essences and the possibilist quantifier, not the tertia via's necessary being (a being that cannot not-be) and not logical necessity.
